card.name: "Lead to" before overdose and death
card.fires_on: The word "to" in "which can lead to overdose and death", right after the list "addiction, abuse, and misuse" in opioid boxed warnings.

modes.label: Opioid boxed warning
modes.description: The word "to" after "which can lead" following addiction, abuse and misuse risks in opioid labels.
modes.example: Because the use of fentanyl transdermal system exposes patients and other users to the risks of opioid addiction, abuse, and misuse, which can lead<< to>> overdose and death, assess each patient’s
